prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one small, elegant botanical ornament for a moody romantic wedding invitation.
Reference image 1 is the visual guide for the flower's shape, palette, and pose. Generate a clean, higher-detail botanical illustration matching that reference: a single open ivory cream rose blossom in a gentle side view near the upper center, soft pale blush shadows on the petals, fine antique champagne-gold and warm brown petal edges, a slender naturally curving olive-green stem descending toward the bottom, and one prominent dark muted olive-green leaf pointing toward the lower left. Keep the bloom and stem delicate, like a vintage hand-painted botanical specimen, with subtle brush texture and realistic organic petal and leaf detail.
Composition: upright portrait canvas approximately 4:5, entire single flower and leaf visible with a modest clear margin, no clipping. Flower head at the top, stem and one leaf below, close to the reference silhouette. This will be displayed as a small centered ornament below a paragraph on a deep espresso background.
Background: genuinely transparent everywhere outside the botanical silhouette; no cream paper rectangle, checkerboard, colored field, cast shadow or vignette.
Constraints: one flower only, no bouquet, vase, ribbon, frame, text, symbols, logos or watermarks. No heavy outline, cartoon styling or shiny metallic petals. Preserve the natural ivory, antique-gold accents and muted olive palette.
authorization: User explicitly requested generating this flower and placing it after the Our Story paragraph.
use: Decorative ornament centered after the final Our Story paragraph; 80px wide on phones and 96px on larger screens.
